remarks: Newly Renovated & Spacious Apartment - 2-3 Bedrooms, 3 Full Baths! This beautifully renovated and oversized apartment features 2-3 bedrooms, 3 full bathrooms, and all newer appliances-including a premium Wolf gas range with hood, extra large stainless refrigerator, dishwasher and full-size washer and dryer. The layout offers great flow, with polished hardwood floors on the main level and a tiled family room or additional bedroom downstairs, complete with its own full bath. A bright alcove with a floor-to-ceiling window makes a perfect home office, offering an abundance of natural sunlight. Additional highlights include off-street parking for two cars, plus plenty of on-street parking. Located in the desirable Belltown neighborhood of Stamford, you're just a short walk to grocery stores, CVS, restaurants, and more. Ceiling fans are installed in all main-level living spaces and bedrooms. The primary bedroom features an en suite bath, and there is an additional full bathroom in the hallway on the main level. Enjoy relaxing on the charming covered front porch-perfect for kicking back and unwinding.
